arguments.sql: SELECT products.name AS Produkt, SUM(order_lines.quantity) AS Menge, SUM(order_lines.quantity * products.unit_price) AS Betrag FROM order_lines JOIN products ON order_lines.product_id = products.id JOIN orders ON order_lines.order_id = orders.id WHERE products.line = 'Spare parts' AND orders.order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-12-31' GROUP BY products.name

arguments.subject: Spare parts 2026
arguments.body: Anbei die Mengen und Beträge der Spare-parts-Produkte für 2026.
